offers_products.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes, primarily entry-level, across Southeast and Texas markets.

offers_services.reason: Homebuilding sales are the main offering; any title or mortgage services are secondary to selling homes.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells new homes directly to individual homebuyers and households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are individual households; no meaningful sales to businesses or government described.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each home is a one-time purchase by a buyer.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to interest rates.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest and most infrequent purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for finished homes, a physical product, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual households buying homes.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light homebuilder using controlled lots and subcontractors; investment is mainly land and inventory, not plants or fleets.
